claim_ceiling.pilot: implementation feasibility, C0 predictive validity, optimizer and P/Q feasibility, and measured timing only
claim_ceiling.stage1: task-local controlled algorithmic effect relative to B and one fixed C placebo
claim_ceiling.stage2: task-local placebo-relative reliance on one offline predictive projector

canonical_hashing.json: sha256(UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and separators comma and colon)
canonical_hashing.directory: sort files by POSIX relative path; for each file append UTF-8 canonical JSON line with keys bytes,path,sha256; sha256 the concatenated lines

filesystem_contract.project_data_artifact_io: every project, data, model, checkpoint, environment, cache, temporary, log, metric, video, W&B, and result path must be specified under the logical personal root and resolve under the canonical personal root
filesystem_contract.new_output_rule: canonical parent must pass the personal-root check before creation; reject symlink escape; use umask 077; output UUID directories must not preexist
runtime_read_only_exceptions: /proc entries needed for the current launch and GPU occupancy
system executables and read-only runtime libraries
filesystem_contract.runtime_exception_limits: exceptions may not be used to read project data, model data, checkpoints, another user's home, or team/shared storage and may never be written
forbidden_actions: read or write team/shared project, dataset, model, or checkpoint trees
kill, attach to, overwrite, or reuse an unrelated process
touch the dirty CF-DynAlign source as an experiment runtime

dirty_source.policy: read-only provenance audit only; never modify and never use as the H1 runtime

host_environment.implementation_dependency_rule: use only locked environment packages; PCA, ridge, bootstrap, and statistics use NumPy, SciPy, or PyTorch; scikit-learn is not present and must not be installed

rng.role_derivation_fallback: uint64 big-endian first 8 bytes of SHA256 of PGR-Audit-v1|role={role}|train_seed={train_seed}|master=1701

immutable_order: freeze and hash protocol, input manifest, seed order, paths, budget atoms, quarantine rules, and source/environment locks
perform CPU/static source, path, and evaluator-semantics validation only; no model scoring, representation cache, parity, training, or GPU timing

after renewed jury approval, create the isolated personal source, materialize locks, implement the launch guard, sealed screen evaluator, and downstream code, pass CPU tests and fresh-agent code review, but do not load a model or launch a GPU
make the 1k, 5k, and 10k checkpoint screen the first and contiguous GPU launch class; run the seeded kernel witness inside the first screen launch envelope before checkpoint loading
automatically select and hash the checkpoint; stop if none qualifies
run a conditional timing-only 520-step trace only if the screen contains no real horizon failure
validate selected-checkpoint identity, direct-cache, hot-switch, data-window, and evaluator parity
build the selected-checkpoint cache and target, train head and controls, and open strict-test once
stop as H1 NO-RUN if C0 fails
build and hash the fixed C donor map
run the already-preregistered seed-0 A/B/C, P/Q folds0-3, and timing with scientific metrics sealed
compute seed count automatically from timing-only ledger fields and hash seed_count.json
reveal seed-0 offline metrics, apply immutable eligibility gates, and train the remaining fixed seed prefix
freeze every seed's folds0-3 P/Q and all parity artifacts
open fold4 exactly once for all selected seeds
run and seal all 300 Stage-1 rollouts; reveal once complete
run and seal all 200 Stage-2 rollouts only if Stage 1 and every Stage-2 eligibility row pass
run integrity audit and result-to-claim; do not write a paper

tasks.instruction: put the black bowl in the bottom drawer of the cabinet and close it
put the white mug on the plate and put the chocolate pudding to the right of the plate

split_algorithm.sort_key: full lowercase SHA256 hex of UTF-8 PGR-Audit-v1|task={dataset_task_index}|episode={episode_index}|stream={stream}|seed=1701; tie episode_index ascending
split_algorithm.allocator: within each task, floor n*p for each label, then distribute remaining items by descending fractional remainder with label-order tie break; assign sorted episode list to contiguous label blocks
split_algorithm.reason_for_repaired_proportions: the original 50/30/20 equal-fold sketch leaves only one fold4 episode per task; this frozen cardinality-aware allocation retains three locked fold4 episodes per task and is subject to renewed review

data.valid_window: retain t only when t + 8 < episode_length; never pad or cross an episode
data.host_processor: selected checkpoint's clean-HEAD QwenOFT processor in eval mode with no random augmentation; resolved config and source hashes must match INPUT_MANIFEST.json

action_normalization.dimension_6_gripper: identity, matching the clean Libero4in1DataConfig which does not normalize action.gripper

host_model.action_head_loss: mean absolute error over batch, 8 tokens, and 7 normalized action dimensions

adapter.formula: m = h + U @ V @ LN0(h) applied tokenwise
adapter.layer_norm: population variance over 2560 features, eps 1e-5, no affine

future_target.encoder: DINOv2 ViT-S/14 local source and local weight, strict state-dict load, eval, FP32, x_norm_clstoken

whitening.covariance: population covariance per camera in FP64

projection.generator: NumPy PCG64 seed 1701, draw main then wrist, each Gaussian matrix shape 384 by 32
projection.orthonormalization: reduced QR; fix each column sign so its maximum-absolute element is positive

future_target.target: concatenate the 32-D main and 32-D wrist projected whitened differences

nuisance_residualization.covariates: z-scored current main CLS, z-scored current wrist CLS, task one-hot in dataset task order 1 then 8, progress, intercept
nuisance_residualization.continuous_stats: D_head train only with population std floor 1e-6
nuisance_residualization.cv: five episode-level task-stratified folds allocated by the same largest-remainder algorithm with stream head_nuisance_cv
nuisance_residualization.selection: minimum task-equal D_head-val nMSE rounded to 12 decimals; tie choose larger alpha
nuisance_residualization.train_target: out-of-fold residual on D_head train at selected alpha
nuisance_residualization.other_target: fit ridge on all D_head train and subtract prediction on val, strict-test, D_adapter, and D_post
nuisance_residualization.linear_solver: FP64 solve of Z^T Z + alpha*D; use Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse with rcond 1e-12 only if direct solve fails; record fallback and fail if nonfinite

predictive_decoder.ln0: population feature normalization eps 1e-5 no affine per token
predictive_decoder.state_branch: mean across 8 LN0 tokens, Linear 2560 to 256 with bias, GELU
predictive_decoder.action_branch: flatten exact 8 by 7 normalized action chunk, Linear 56 to 128 with bias, GELU
predictive_decoder.fusion: concatenate to exactly 384 dimensions, Linear 384 to 256 with bias, GELU, Linear 256 to 64 with bias
predictive_decoder.initialization: PyTorch 2.6.0 default Linear initialization under seed 1701
predictive_decoder.training_loss: mean squared error over batch and 64 target dimensions
predictive_decoder.batching: task-balanced batches; within each task sample windows from a seed-1701 shuffled list without replacement per epoch
predictive_decoder.selection: lowest task-equal D_head-val joint64 nMSE rounded to 12 decimals; tie earliest epoch

controls.common_training: same optimizer, batches, epochs, early stopping, and seed as full unless control is closed form
controls.state_only: same full architecture with the 56-D action input identically zero in train and evaluation
controls.action_only: same full architecture with the 2560-D pooled representation input identically zero in train and evaluation
controls.current_dino_action: z-scored concatenated current main and wrist CLS, Linear 768 to 256 with bias and GELU, then the same action branch and 384 to 256 to 64 fusion
controls.additive: same state and action branches; Linear 256 to 64 with bias plus Linear 128 to 64 without bias
controls.nuisance_ridge: same nuisance covariates and alpha grid fit directly to residual target
controls.task_progress_mean: D_head-train task by progress-decile mean; empty bin falls back to task mean then global mean

nmse.reference_mean: D_head-train residual target mean for the evaluated coordinate set
nmse.per_task: sum squared prediction error divided by sum squared deviation from fixed train reference mean
nmse.aggregate: equal mean of task-index 1 and task-index 8 nMSE

metrics.derangement_degradation: nMSE(deranged full decoder) / nMSE(intact full decoder) - 1

bootstrap.sampling: within each task sample the original number of episodes with replacement and retain every window of each sampled episode; task-equal aggregate

metrics.projector_r2: task-equal mean of 1 - SSE(model)/SSE(zero), where zero is the folds0-1 fit-target mean and each task is scored separately
metrics.permutation_p: (1 + count(T_perm >= T_observed)) / 1001 using 1000 within-task episode-block target permutations

strict_predictive_gate.evaluated_once_on: D_head strict_test after all decoder, nuisance, whitening, projections, splits, preprocessing, controls, and hashes freeze

action_derangement.constraints: different episode, same task, progress-decile and action-norm-tercile when feasible; use the fixed C merge hierarchy; no fixed point

representation_derangement.constraints: different episode, same task, progress-decile and action-norm-tercile when feasible; keep the demonstrated action fixed; use the fixed C merge hierarchy; no fixed point

fixed_c_placebo.action_norm: L2 norm of flattened normalized 56-D action divided by sqrt(56)
fixed_c_placebo.action_terciles: per task on D_adapter using NumPy quantile method inverted_cdf; an exact boundary belongs to the lower bin
merge_levels: progress decile with all action terciles
progress quintile floor(decile/2) with all action terciles
progress half floor(decile/5) with all action terciles
fixed_c_placebo.merge_selection: choose the first whole-dataset level at which every stratum has a perfect bijective derangement under different-episode and nonoverlapping-window constraints; do not choose locally or by outcome
fixed_c_placebo.huber: elementwise 0.5*e^2 if abs(e)<=1 else abs(e)-0.5, mean over 64 dimensions
fixed_c_placebo.target_scalar: L2 target norm divided by sqrt(64)
fixed_c_placebo.cost: squared standardized query-donor target-norm difference plus squared standardized difference between intact identity Huber loss and query-prediction-to-donor-target Huber loss
fixed_c_placebo.cost_scales: population standard deviations over all eligible D_adapter pairs, each floored at 1e-8
fixed_c_placebo.solver: SciPy linear_sum_assignment in float64; invalid edges are infinity
fixed_c_placebo.tie_break: add 1e-12 times uint64(first 8 SHA256 bytes of PGR-Audit-v1|C|query_sample_id|donor_sample_id) divided by 2^64 to every finite cost

arms.A: action gradient plus valid future-target gradient
arms.B: action gradient only; compute and log the same frozen future forward without auxiliary update
arms.C: action gradient plus fixed C-donor future-target gradient

shared.batching: exactly 128 samples per task; pre-generate and hash every batch index array using torch.Generator seed 10000+train_seed; sample with deterministic epoch cycling
shared.dtype: FP32 gradients, norms, scales, and updates

adapter_training.future_loss: mean elementwise Huber delta 1 over batch and 64 dimensions
adapter_training.gradient_norm: L2 over the concatenation of every U and V gradient element before clipping

dose.rho: 0.30 * norm of B action gradient on the common batch
dose.composition: combine action and scaled future gradients, then apply global norm clip 1.0
dose.fallback: future norm <=1e-12, rho<=1e-12, scale hits either cap, or relative error >0.01

adapter_training.nonfinite: immediate seed invalid and stop that launch

predictive_projector.delta: mean across 8 tokens of m_A - m_B in 2560-D

fold_roles.fold2: alpha and rank selection plus permutation gate

nuisance.covariates: z-scored current DINO main and wrist CLS, demonstrated normalized action chunk, task one-hot, progress, intercept
nuisance.crossfit: fit fold0 predict fold1 and fit fold1 predict fold0 for delta and target independently
nuisance.selection: lowest average task-equal OOF nMSE rounded to 12 decimals; tie larger alpha
nuisance.refit: union folds0-1 at the selected alpha for folds2-4

W.fit_values: fold0-1 OOF delta residuals after nuisance subtraction
W.raw_center: mean raw delta on folds0-1, stored as mu_delta
W.dimension: smallest d explaining at least 95 percent residual variance, capped at 128
W.matrix: diag(retained_eigenvalues^-0.5) times retained eigenvectors transpose, shape d by 2560

B_N.values: W times centered union-refit nuisance-predicted delta on folds0-1
B_N.basis: left singular vectors in W space explaining at least 95 percent nuisance-prediction energy
B_N.zero_energy: empty basis when total squared singular value <=1e-12

p_fit.method: multivariate ridge coefficient from W-space OOF residual delta to OOF residual target, then truncate coefficient SVD
p_fit.basis: take coefficient left singular vectors, project into complement of B_N, reduced QR with canonical positive signs
p_fit.selection: lowest task-equal fold2 nMSE rounded to 12 decimals; tie lower rank then larger alpha

q_fit.generation: Gaussian d by selected-rank matrix from the fixed candidate seed; project into complement of B_N and B_pred; reduced QR with canonical signs
q_fit.invalid: numerical rank less than selected rank
q_fit.score: squared log energy ratio plus mean squared log of the 16 task-token action perturbation ratios
q_fit.selection: lowest score rounded to 12 decimals; tie lower candidate index

projectors.nuisance_overlap: Frobenius norm of B_R.T @ B_N divided by sqrt(rank)

deployment.pseudoinverse: NumPy pinv(W,rcond=1e-8), linear only and never restore a mean
deployment.application: subtract the same 2560-D vector from each of the 8 A tokens

predictive_projector.fold4_r2: fit a readout from projected coordinates to residual target on folds0-1 with selected alpha; score task-equal R2 on fold4; Q uses the same alpha without retuning

stage1_every_seed: A valid-target joint64 and main32 nMSE each beat identity, B, and C by at least 5 percent with one-sided episode-bootstrap LCB > 0
adapter residual RMS <= 10 percent of h RMS
identity, direct-cache, and hot-switch normalized-action max error < 1e-6
C matching, dose, optimizer, and nonfinite gates pass
eligibility.stage1_failure: any selected seed failure forbids Stage 1; no seed replacement
stage2_every_seed: P fold4 point R2 >= 0.02 and episode-bootstrap LCB > 0
P/Q removed-energy ratio and every task-token action-output perturbation ratio in [0.9,1.1]
A-to-B cached parity and two reserved deterministic-trace normalized-action max errors < 1e-6
fold4 PCA-distance support <= folds0-3 99th percentile and normalized action values within folds0-3 coordinatewise range
eligibility.stage2_failure: any selected seed failure globally forbids Stage 2 but does not invalidate a passed Stage 1
eligibility.fold4_bootstrap: same 10000-replicate task-stratified episode-block procedure; fold4 has exactly three episodes per task

checkpoint_screen.qualification: each task success rate independently in [0.2,0.8]
checkpoint_screen.selection: among qualified checkpoints minimize absolute pooled success rate minus 0.5; tie lower step
checkpoint_screen.selector_output: selected checkpoint step, path, bytes, SHA256, selector-rule hash, and sealed-screen artifact hash
checkpoint_screen.detail_reveal: screen details may be revealed only after selected_checkpoint.json is atomically written and hashed

closed_loop_evaluation.chunk_execution: open loop execute all 8 returned actions before the next policy query
closed_loop_evaluation.horizon: done false at horizon is a failure
closed_loop_evaluation.exception_or_missing: stage invalid; never convert to a failure success label and never impute

stage1.sign_gate_10: at least 9 of 10 seed-level paired differences positive; ties nonpositive; exact one-sided p=11/1024
stage1.sign_gate_5: 5 of 5 seed-level paired differences positive; ties nonpositive; exact one-sided p=1/32

classes.screen: seal raw metrics, stdout, stderr, videos, and trajectories until selected_checkpoint.json is hashed
classes.pilot_training: before seed_count.json is hashed, expose only exit code, GPU seconds, peak memory, nonfinite boolean, safety-gate booleans, and artifact hashes; seal losses, R2, nMSE, P/Q score, and comparative arm metrics
classes.stage1: seal every rollout and all intermediate summaries until all 300 expected records exist and the batch manifest hash passes
classes.stage2: seal every rollout and all intermediate summaries until all 200 expected records exist and the batch manifest hash passes

outcome_isolation.seed_count_reader: schema-level deny access to sealed scientific metric paths and fields
outcome_isolation.wandb: offline only and sealed with its phase
outcome_isolation.failed_attempts: preserve and charge; never delete or overwrite

budget.actual_definition: for each physical GPU UUID, measure the union of this run's launch intervals; sum union lengths across UUIDs and divide by 3600
budget.child_process_rule: children included in a charged launch envelope are attributed but not charged again
budget.seed0_artifact_policy: seed-0 triplet and folds0-3 P/Q are formal retained artifacts
disjoint_cost_atoms: two reserved deterministic-trace parities per seed
model-server loads and teardown not already included in a measured atom

unit_bounds.u_triplet: 1.10 times measured seed-0 complete retained triplet GPUh including its load and teardown
unit_bounds.u_pq03: 1.10 times measured retained seed-0 folds0-3 P/Q GPUh
unit_bounds.u_fold4: 1.10 times a fold3 shadow timing scaled by fold4 sample count; never open fold4 for timing
unit_bounds.u_seed_parity: 1.10 times measured seed-0 complete parity bundle including two reserved traces
unit_bounds.u_roll: 1.10 * (max(real horizon-failure seconds, maximum screen rollout seconds) + measured 65-chunk wrapper overhead seconds) / 3600
unit_bounds.u_stage_load: 1.10 times measured resident base load and teardown per future stage
unit_bounds.u_retry: 0.20 GPUh, at most one infrastructure-only retry before Stage1

budget.projection_formula: pre_n = spent + active_remaining_UB + (n-1)*u_triplet + (n-1)*u_pq03 + n*u_fold4 + n*u_seed_parity + 500*u_roll + stage_load_atoms + u_retry; projection_n = pre_n + max(0.10*pre_n,0.30)
budget.seed_decision: choose 10 iff projection_10 <= 7.2; else choose 5 iff projection_5 <= 7.2; else STOP
budget.decision_inputs: timing, resource, exit, hash, and safety fields only; scientific outcomes forbidden
budget.post_decision_admission: recompute selected complete-path projection before every launch and require <=7.2 with no force override
budget.hard_stop: before launch reserve 0.05 GPUh teardown margin; watchdog may terminate only its own process group at the monotonic deadline; actual remains charged; never touch an external process

launch_guard.snapshot: one fresh nvidia-smi/NVML snapshot of physical indices 0-3, hardware UUIDs, compute PIDs, process owners when readable, memory used, and utilization
launch_guard.idle_definition: no compute process, memory.used <= 500 MiB, and utilization.gpu <= 5 percent
launch_guard.normal_rule: if requested GPU count can be satisfied by idle physical 2 and 3, allocate only from 2 then 3
launch_guard.gpu_0_1_rule: 0 or 1 may be used only for one atomic launch group when the same fresh snapshot shows all four GPUs idle; assignment order in that group is 2,3,0,1
launch_guard.binding: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES uses the verified hardware UUIDs
launch_guard.post_bind: after CUDA context creation, take a second snapshot and verify assigned UUIDs and that every new PID belongs to this launch PID/PGID; an occupancy race stops only this launch
launch_guard.failure: fail closed, charge any elapsed GPU time, preserve artifacts, and never kill or attach to an external PID

failure_and_retry.scientific_gate_failure: stop or narrow the claim exactly as specified; never retry, tune, change seed, or replace a seed
failure_and_retry.infrastructure_retry: at most one pre-Stage1 retry for a predeclared infrastructure error class, new launch UUID and new GPU snapshot, old cost retained, unchanged config and seed
failure_and_retry.stage1_stage2_retry: none; any exception, missing record, or incomplete batch invalidates that stage and leaves partial outcomes sealed for audit
failure_and_retry.budget_failure: NO-RUN, never remove a control or conditional Stage2 cost to fit
failure_and_retry.pilot_overrun: refuse the next launch; no result claim
